info.name: Project Management API
info.description: API endpoints for the Project Management System

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Endpoints for authentication and token management

item.name: Login
item.description: Log in with username/email and password

item.name: Login (with Email)
item.description: Log in with email and password

item.name: Verify 2FA
item.description: Verify 2FA code after login (if 2FA is enabled)

item.name: Verify Backup Code
item.description: Verify with backup code if 2FA code is not available

item.name: Refresh Token
item.description: Get a new access token using refresh token

item.name: Verify Token
item.description: Verify if access token is valid

item.name: Password Reset Confirm
item.description: Reset password using token and UID

item.name: Enable 2FA
item.description: Enable two-factor authentication - returns secret key for TOTP

item.name: Confirm 2FA
item.description: Confirm 2FA setup by validating a code

item.name: List Users
item.description: Get a list of all users (paginated)

item.name: Get User
item.description: Get a specific user by ID

item.name: Partial Update User
item.description: Update only specific fields of a user

item.name: Available Filters
item.description: Get available filter options for user endpoints

item.name: Available Aggregations
item.description: Get available aggregation options for user endpoints

item.name: Filtered Users
item.description: Get users filtered by specific criteria

item.name: Aggregated Users
item.description: Get user data with specified aggregations

item.name: Organization Management
item.description: Endpoints for managing organizations, departments, and teams

item.name: Team Management
item.description: Endpoints for managing teams and team members

item.name: Contact Management
item.description: Endpoints for managing contacts, groups, templates, and notes
